use anyhow::{ensure,Result};use erc20_balances_storage_tools::data::*;use serde_json::{json,Value};use std::{fs,path::Path};
fn load(path:&Path)->Result<Value>{Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(path)?)?)}
fn excerpt(path:&Path,ranges:&[(u64,u64)])->Result<Vec<String>>{Ok(fs::read_to_string(path)?.lines().filter(|line|line.split(':').next().and_then(|v|v.parse::<u64>().ok()).is_some_and(|pc|ranges.iter().any(|(a,b)|pc>=*a&&pc<=*b))).map(str::to_owned).collect())}
fn main()->Result<()> {let root=Path::new("erc20/balances-storage");let out=root.join("out/og450-model-export-final");fs::create_dir(&out)?;let fixtures=root.join("tests/fixtures/og-model");fs::create_dir_all(&fixtures)?;
let mut historical=load(&root.join("out/og450-model-controls/historical.json"))?;let base=load(&root.join("out/og450-model-boundaries/base-snapshot.json"))?;historical[0]["raw_state"]=base["raw_state"].clone();let original=load(&root.join("out/next450-mismatch-compact/report.json"))?;
let mut dependency_coverage=vec![];for (i,c)in historical.as_array_mut().unwrap().iter_mut().enumerate(){ensure!(c["status"]=="match","failed historical");c.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("model");c["original_failure"]=original["cases"][i]["original"].clone();let reads=items(&original["cases"][i]["contexts"],"storage_reads")?;for r in reads {let found=items(c,"raw_state")?.iter().find(|w|w["contract"]==r["storage_address"]&&w["key"]==r["key"]);ensure!(found.is_some_and(|w|w["value"]==r["value"]),"unbound sampled SLOAD case{}: {} {}",i+1,r["storage_address"],r["key"]);}dependency_coverage.push(json!({"case":i+1,"observed_sloads":reads.len(),"all_observed_values_bound_to_fresh_raw_words":true}));}
let mut controls=load(&root.join("out/og450-model-controls/controls.json"))?.as_array().unwrap().clone();controls.extend(load(&root.join("out/og450-model-boundaries/controls.json"))?.as_array().unwrap().clone());for c in &mut controls{ensure!(c["status"]=="match"||c["status"]=="explicitly_unsupported","failed control");c.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("model");}
fs::write(fixtures.join("historical.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&historical)?)?;fs::write(fixtures.join("controls.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&controls)?)?;
let capture=load(&root.join("out/og450-model-capture/report.json"))?;let price=load(&root.join("out/og450-model-price-review/report.json"))?;
let report=json!({"status":"bounded_host_model_not_qualified","promoted_layouts":0,"historical_cases":5,"matched_controls":40,"explicitly_unsupported_controls":3,
"runtime_bindings":historical[0]["runtime_bindings"],"sampled_storage_read_coverage":dependency_coverage,"source_status":"Token and helper Sourcify v2 source lookup returned 404; conclusions derive from hash-bound deployed bytecode, raw storage and read-only controls, not verified Solidity names.",
"original_failures":items(&original,"cases")?.iter().take(5).map(|c|c["original"].clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
"historical_summary":items(&capture,"cases")?.iter().map(|c|json!({"case":c["case"],"holder":c["holder"],"block":c["block"],"hash":c["hash"],"timestamp":c["timestamp"],"balance":c["model"]["balance"],"hourly":c["model"]["hourly"],"daily":c["model"]["daily"],"stopping_hour":c["model"]["hour_stop"],"hourly_periods":c["model"]["hour_steps"].as_array().unwrap().len(),"daily_periods":c["model"]["day_steps"].as_array().unwrap().len()})).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
"storage_roots":{"token_fixed":{"helper_address":6,"epoch":29},"helper_fixed":{"token_address":1,"pool_address":2},"token_address_mappings":{"raw_balance":0,"holder_record":9,"claimed_cap_value":10,"cursor_record":11,"last_guard_hour":39,"guard_amount":40},"token_period_mappings":{"hour_total":23,"hour_reward":24,"day_total":25,"day_reward":27},"token_nested_address_period_mappings":{"hour_user":12,"day_user":13},"pool_fixed":{"packed_reserves":8}},
"holder_record":"mapping9 base low160=field0 address; byte20=field1 uint8; base+1..11=ABI fields2..12. Field5 hourly fallback, field6 daily gate, field3 cap basis, field12 existing holding. Descriptive labels are bytecode-derived, not verified source names.",
"arithmetic":{"hourly":"Start lastHour, exclusive stop=min(currentHour,lastHour+168). Nonzero total/user updates carry; initial zero user falls back to holder field5. Each contribution floor(reward*user/total).","daily":"Start lastDay, stop at currentDay or after three periods with all total/user/reward positive. A positive-input contribution whose quotient floors to zero still counts. Initial zero user and reward=0 with total>0 remain unsupported.","cap":"If field12>0: checked currentHour-last39>168 =>0; else checked field12*5 then amount40*100; provided<required=>0. cap=field3*3; cap<=claimed10=>0. Remaining=cap-claimed10. price=two-hop amountOut(1e18). existing=floor(field12*price/1e18); existing>=remaining=>0. If existing+floor(reward*price/1e18)>remaining, result=floor((remaining-existing)*1e18/price), else reward.","router":price["formula"],"reserve_direction":"Pool A reserve1 token input to reserve0 WBNB; pool B reserve1 WBNB input to reserve0 USDT. Both floor at each hop.","balance":"Checked raw + hourly then + daily. No expected RPC balance/helper output enters the model."},
"helper_bytecode_excerpts":excerpt(&root.join("out/og450-model-review/helper-runtime.txt"),&[(7058,7088),(7176,7274),(7387,7392),(7517,7728),(8690,8722),(10392,10564),(10577,10615),(10964,11106)])?,
"clock_source":"At PC7062 SLOAD consumes slot1 after PUSH1 01; PUSH0; SWAP1. EXP256^0=1, so DIV applies no byte shift. Trace confirms helper slot1 TOKEN clock source, already address-bound.",
"router_bytecode_excerpts":excerpt(&root.join("out/og450-model-price-review/router-runtime.txt"),&[(16080,16270)])?,"router_fee_operands":price["fee_multiplications"],"router_reserve_scale_operands":price["reserve_scale_multiplications"],
"controls_summary":controls.iter().map(|c|json!({"name":c["name"],"status":c["status"]})).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
"limitations":["No production layout, Substreams replay/state retention, holder enumeration, or cross-network support.","Unmodeled hourly/daily zero-reward burn preview when carried total is positive.","Unmodeled initial zero daily user rate and recursive pool reward when pool hourly rate is nonzero.","Only reviewed runtime and address bindings; fixture daily horizon<=1000. Missing raw words reject; snapshots do not establish how to keep all dependencies current.","Numeric checked overflow rejection is modeled; router revert ABI and arbitrary unreviewed branches are not claimed."],
"tracked_fixtures":{"historical":{"path":"tests/fixtures/og-model/historical.json","sha256":sha256(&fixtures.join("historical.json"))?},"controls":{"path":"tests/fixtures/og-model/controls.json","sha256":sha256(&fixtures.join("controls.json"))?}},
"source_artifacts":["out/og450-model-source/report.json","out/og450-model-review/report.json","out/og450-model-getters/report.json","out/og450-model-price-review/report.json","out/og450-model-capture/report.json","out/og450-model-controls/report.json","out/og450-model-boundaries/report.json"],
"next_bounded_work":"Decode helper zero-reward preview bodies at PCs11119(hourly),6559(daily), and daily initial-rate fallback at3852..3881, with fresh state/clock controls; keep retained state and production qualification separate."});
fs::write(root.join("docs/evidence/og450-host-model.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&report)?)?;fs::write(out.join("report.json"),serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"status":"exported","historical_sha256":sha256(&fixtures.join("historical.json"))?,"controls_sha256":sha256(&fixtures.join("controls.json"))?,"evidence_sha256":sha256(&root.join("docs/evidence/og450-host-model.json"))?}))?)?;Ok(())}
